long_biography.plain_text:
Peter Hürzeler had intended to become a lawyer before choosing a life at sea. At twenty-one he joined the merchant fleet, completing circumnavigations on commercial ships. He later joined friends in persuading investors to finance a charter venture, combining their seafaring skills with the service expected by holidaymakers.

Running that business gave him practical experience of the needs of customers and crews, which informed his subsequent advisory work. Life at sea also offered a quieter pleasure: during night watches, he could spend hours on the bridge wing looking across the water and up at the stars.

confidence.reason: His directly read first-person company interview establishes the intended legal career, merchant service, investor-financed commercial concept, practical customer/crew lessons and enjoyment of night watches. It does not claim a completed law degree or speculate about the investors' identities.
